callees.name: generate_topdown_layers
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is an existing directory containing extracted functions and a phases.json file. extra_call_edges, if provided, is an iterable of supplemental caller/callee edge records describing call relationships not visible to static analysis.
callees.post_condition: Generates per-phase topdown layer JSON files under proj_dir/spec_prompts/ with filenames format phase_NN_topdown_layers.json for each phase (filtered to phase_numbers when provided). Each file contains a JSON object with keys 'phase' (int), 'phase_name' (str), 'total_functions' (int), 'total_layers' (int), and 'layers' (list). Each layer object has integer 'layer' and a 'functions' list of objects each containing at minimum 'name' (FQN string), 'file' (relative path), 'all_callees' (list of all callee FQN strings). Functions within a layer appear in topological order where callees precede callers. Returns the list of absolute output file paths written.

callees.name: _load_phases
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is an existing directory containing a readable phases.json file at proj_dir/phases.json.
callees.post_condition: Returns the parsed JSON contents of proj_dir/phases.json as a dict. The returned dict has a 'phases' key whose value is a list of phase objects, each containing at minimum integer 'phase' and string 'name' keys.
